motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Navigation hover and active-state changes only.

components.name: Page Navigation
components.description: Square numbered controls for the three report screens.
components.css: .ds-page-nav { width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid #0e6675; background: #0e6675; color: #fff; font: 600 10px/1 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-page-nav:hover, .ds-page-nav:focus-visible { background: #2e8fa3; outline: 2px solid #0e6675; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Comparison Bar
components.description: Aligned label, zero-axis track, and tabular measurement.
components.css: .ds-compare { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 82px 180px 70px; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font: 600 12px/1 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-compare span { height: 12px; border-left: 1px solid #69717c; background: #e2e5e3; } .ds-compare i { display: block; width: 28%; height: 100%; background: #0e6675; } .ds-compare output { color: #4f5662; font: 600 10px/1 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; text-align: right; }

narrative.overview: An institutional, presentation-first evidence artifact built from white paper, black rules, warm measurement fields, and one restrained teal signal.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal marks the principal mechanism or Jev series; comparator data stays neutral gray.

donts: Do not generalize the smoke fixture.
